title: Golu and the Great Munchy Mix-Up
moral: Kindness means giving others what they really need.
description: Golu the goat is SO hungry he's eating Dadaji's newspaper! So Laddu and Chintu set off across Masti Nagar to find out what every animal really eats, from Gauri the cow to the parrots in the mango tree. Learn what cows, parrots, ducks and goats eat in this funny animated kindness story for kids aged 3 to 8.

narration.text: Good morning, Masti Nagar! The sun was up, and Golu the goat was up too!

narration.text: Ba-a-a-a!

narration.speaker: dadaji
narration.text: Snnnork... I'm awake! I was just resting my eyes! Now, where is my newspaper?

narration.speaker: laddu
narration.text: Arre wah! Golu is having breakfast. Is it jalebi time for me too?

narration.text: IDEA! Golu is SUPER hungry! Let's find out what every animal really eats, and give them the right food!

narration.speaker: laddu
narration.text: Easy peasy! All animals eat... jalebis!
Hee hee! No, Laddu! That's YOUR favourite food!

narration.speaker: dadaji
narration.text: Ho ho HO! Goats like Golu eat grass and green leaves. Not newspapers!

narration.speaker: chintu
narration.text: Don't worry, I have a plan... a slightly wobbly plan! Chalo, dost!

narration.text: First stop, the busy market! By the chai stall stood Gauri the cow.

narration.speaker: laddu
narration.text: Here you go, Gauri! One yummy jalebi!
But Gauri turned up her nose. Hmmph! No, thank you!
What do YOU think a cow likes to eat?
Grass and hay! Ding! Cows munch grass and hay all day long!
Laddu and Chintu both grabbed the hay. Pull! Pull! PULL! BOING! The hay split... PLOP! Down they sat!
And who popped up to eat the hay off Laddu's head?

narration.text: Look, Chintu! They're nibbling mangoes and pecking at little seeds!
Yes! Parrots eat fruits and seeds. Fruits and seeds! Wah!
Chintu wrote it on his list. Then... MUNCH! Golu ate the list!

narration.text: Then a tummy went GRRR-UMBLE. Not Laddu's this time... it was Golu's! He was still hungry.
Laddu could smell hot jalebis. Mmmm! But he looked at Golu's sad little face.

narration.speaker: laddu
narration.text: Jalebis can wait. Golu needs real goat food. Grass and green leaves!

narration.speaker: chintu
narration.text: IDEA! I'll hold the leaves on a long stick, like this... whoa... WHOA!
BONK! Golu head-butted the stick, and Chintu spun round and round! Wibble-wobble!
Then Laddu sat down and gently held out a big bunch of fresh leaves. Munch, munch, munch!

narration.speaker: golu
narration.text: Ba-a-a-a!

narration.text: That evening, the friends told Dadaji everything. Gauri had hay. The parrots had mangoes. The ducks had water plants. And Golu had a tummy full of leaves!

narration.speaker: dadaji
narration.text: Ho ho HO! You gave every animal the food it really needs. That is true kindness!
And guess what Dadaji brought out? A big plate of jalebis!

narration.speaker: laddu
narration.text: Arre wah, jalebi time! One for Dadaji, one for Chintu... and one for me!
Then Dadaji hunted for his glasses. Under the plate? No! They were on his head! Hee hee!
